name: base_utils
description: Manages shared Linux utilities, including the MOTD and configurable utility packages, with reusable Puppet types and functions, custom facts, Hiera data, and operational tasks and plans.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Prepares Python, deploys an application repository, configures PostgreSQL connectivity and migrations, creates a systemd service, and manages monitoring and log rotation.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Manages HAProxy installation and generated configuration, including backend definitions, health checks, statistics access, firewall behavior, custom error pages, optional service discovery, and TLS termination.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL by managing the package repository, version-specific packages, and service in repository-to-install-to-service order.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Installs and configures Redis nodes with persistence, memory policies, password protection, and PuppetDB-based cluster node discovery.
